results.title: A Home of Their Own: PEARC26 Debuts a Dedicated Research Software Engineering Special Track
results.description: When ACM PEARC26 happens July 26-30 at the Minneapolis Convention Center, it will mark two firsts at once. The conference series, which began as PEARC17 in 2017 and has been sponsored by ACM and its SIGHPC and SIGAPP special interest groups since PEARC20, will celebrate its tenth edition with a record-breaking over 1,000 attendees.
